mission: Make it dramatically easier for an ordinary human with a meaningful vision to accomplish extraordinary things with AI without becoming an AI project manager.
human_intent: Continue the first NAYA_ACTION_V1 proof at the actual latest main HEAD, run the machine acceptance against that exact tree, then record the verified result, lesson, and successor baton.
naya_understanding: The machine proof uses a non-self-referential provenance boundary: the proof-bearing action record attests to its immediate parent commit, and CI verifies that parent from the record commit.

authority.human_authorization: Explicit continuation baton in current execution context
authority.execution_scope: Repository-side Naya Power NAYA_ACTION_V1 contract, acceptance, learning, continuity, and required Hub artifact proof

constraints: Do not create a competing state database, renderer, shell, feed, constitution, or continuation system.
Do not claim runtime or production proof without evidence.
Use failure as repair information and preserve fail-closed behavior.
The proof scope must be mechanically identifiable without self-referential SHA claims.
Leave exactly one executable next action.
plan: Execute Primary Intelligence System acceptance against the final proof-bearing tree.
Verify NAYA_ACTION_V1 parent binding, control plane, cold-Naya activation, PIS, and Hub build/parity.
Obtain immutable React/Hub artifact and hash evidence from the successful build.
Transport only that exact artifact if the authorized AppDeploy surface explicitly supports artifact import.
Record the verified result, lesson, and successor baton.

actions.result: Latest main before this proof-record rewrite was 001e70d31f2ea055b597f96d73755c3b6857f4d3.
Acceptance uses fetch-depth 2 and validates proof_scope_head against HEAD^ of the proof-bearing record.
Corrected stale proof scope after run 672; this record now binds proof_scope_head to the immediate parent 001e70d31f2ea055b597f96d73755c3b6857f4d3 of this rewrite commit.

observations: Run 671 failed closed because the prior action record named 9ca2dbc90f4e26138c3523c307b8f20581383900 while its parent was 1dba47b11b4ddc4199030150a8a5e804fe600c2b.

Repair commit 001e70d31f2ea055b597f96d73755c3b6857f4d3 then triggered run 672, which correctly failed closed again because the repair record named 1dba47b11b4ddc4199030150a8a5e804fe600c2b while its immediate parent was d9260af52f1e469d24b86f4014212561fc8eca51.

The failure demonstrates the exact rule: proof_scope_head must equal the immediate parent of the current proof-bearing record commit, not an older historical checkpoint. This rewrite therefore targets parent 001e70d31f2ea055b597f96d73755c3b6857f4d3.

evidence.failure: proof_scope_head 1dba47b11b4ddc4199030150a8a5e804fe600c2b did not equal record parent d9260af52f1e469d24b86f4014212561fc8eca51

result: The proof record has been surgically rebound to the actual immediate parent of this new proof-bearing commit. A fresh acceptance run must now verify the binding and, if successful, proceed through the Hub build/artifact evidence path.

value_cost_risk.value: Makes proof freshness mechanically verifiable and preserves fail-closed provenance.
value_cost_risk.cost: One fresh acceptance/build run and artifact inspection.
value_cost_risk.risk: No artifact or transport success is claimed until immutable evidence exists.

failure_repair.finding: Previous repairs referenced an older checkpoint rather than the current proof-record parent.
failure_repair.repair: Set proof_scope_head to 001e70d31f2ea055b597f96d73755c3b6857f4d3, the immediate parent of this rewrite.

lesson: The proof-bearing record is itself a commit. Therefore its proof scope must always be the exact commit immediately before that record write. Any subsequent rewrite creates a new parent boundary and requires a new fresh acceptance run.
memory: NAYA_ACTION_V1 proof_scope_head equals HEAD^ of the current proof-bearing record commit.
A fresh acceptance must be run after every proof-record rewrite.
Artifact/hash evidence must come from the successful exact-tree build, not from source assumptions.

source.proof_scope_rule: HEAD^ of the proof-bearing record commit

Transport that exact artifact into the existing AppDeploy target only if the authorized AppDeploy transport surface explicitly supports artifact import.
